sociedade.resumo: Isabel Pavão, the Portuguese painter who has lived in New York since 1990, believes that the process of making art matters as much as the finished work. In this episode of The Heart & Hustle of Portugal, the artist retraces a path that runs from Porto to Paris and finally to Manhattan, where she arrived as a doctoral student at New York University, backed by a Gulbenkian grant, to study aesthetics, the language used to talk about art
